description_md: Survey label CCYYMM derived from `cruise_label_effort` (CC2004-07 -> CC0407), the form the sightings carry.
Segment start in UTC, from `datetime_start_local` read as America/Los_Angeles clock time (Q04).
Segment end in UTC, from `datetime_end_local` read as America/Los_Angeles clock time (Q04).
Segment midpoint latitude (mean of start and end), WGS84.
Segment midpoint longitude (mean of start and end), WGS84.
CalCOFI cruise key (YYYY-MM-NODC), carried from the sightings' track match for the same cruise_label.
CalCOFI grid cell of the segment midpoint.
Row number of the sighting in the pinned source file; primary key.
Sighting time in UTC, from `datetime_local` read as America/Los_Angeles clock time (Q04); NULL for the 36 '#REF!' rows (Q06).
Number of calves: `calf_raw` where it is a plain integer, else NULL (Q09).
CalCOFI cruise key (YYYY-MM-NODC) from `match_cruise_by_track()`: nearest ichthyo station occupied the same day, majority vote per cruise_label.
CalCOFI grid cell of the sighting position.
Scientific name the code is resolved from (authored in species_codes.csv; resolved against WoRMS by ensure_taxon_xref()).
